text:
Olivia: Heads up — ACME's APAC procurement flagged our marketplace PO as 'invalid beneficiary'. Portal rejects with 400 'bank_account_mismatch'. PO stuck.
Mike: Link?
Olivia: https://marketplace.example.com/portal/po/PO-2049 (redacted). Error snippet: `{"error":"bank_account_mismatch","expected_entity":"Redwood Inference APAC Pte Ltd"}`
Ella: Is this the new APAC entity we added last month? Did we push the entity alias to the marketplace ledger mapping?
Rajesh: Legal — they insisted on local invoicing in the MSA redline. We created the entity but finance didn't finish bank mapping. cc @matt.finance
Matt: Finance confirms onboarding paused due to missing GST registration docs. I'm pulling the docs now, ETA ~2h.
Olivia: Buyer is pressuring procurement; they may cancel the order by EOD if we don't give an ETA.
chris (deploy-bot): Payment hold created for PO-2049 by marketplace-billing-bot :warning:
Mike: Could we temporarily route this to our EMEA billing entity to unblock? Any tax/contract issues?
Rajesh: Routing to EMEA alters tax treatment and is a contract change — we'd need a signed amendment. Not ideal.
Ella: Short-term workaround: issue a manual invoice from the APAC entity outside the marketplace and reconcile later. Finance: can you issue manual invoice with same SKU/pricing?
Matt: We can do a manual invoice but need the buyer to accept. Also require their PO copy & remittance instructions.
Olivia: I'll ping the buyer (Tom Cheng) now and ask if manual invoice is acceptable.
Tom Cheng: Yes — we can accept a manual invoice for this purchase but prefer marketplace billing. Please escalate.
Mike: If buyer accepts manual invoice, finance can same-day. Finance, please prep pro-forma.
Matt: Preparing pro-forma now. Tag me once buyer confirms screenshot + PO number.
Olivia: Buyer sent screenshot. Pasted error: `ERROR 400: bank_account_mismatch — expected 'Redwood Inference APAC Pte Ltd' — missing beneficiary id`
Rajesh: Legal will draft a short amendment template for gateway routing if needed — keep it one paragraph.
Ella: CS: @james.cs to confirm customer's internal procurement will accept manual invoice.
James: Confirmed — procurement will accept manual invoice but requires PO on file and emailed confirmation.
Olivia: Filed a portal ticket to prevent recurrence: PRTN-4123. Assigning to @nina.portal, P1 for PO flows.
Nina.portal: I see PRTN-4123. Will prioritize after a hotfix deploy. ETA ~6h to update alias mapping.
Matt: Once buyer confirms, finance will issue pro-forma including APAC bank details and remittance instructions.
Olivia: Buyer confirmed. Finance, please send pro-forma and cc legal.
Matt: Sent pro-forma to Tom, cc'd Rajesh — will update when payment posts.
Olivia: After payment, we'll ask marketplace to purge pending PO so we don't double-bill.
chris (deploy-bot): PO-2049: payment status changed to 'manual_invoiced'
James: Customer will process payment within 2 business days.
Olivia: Post-mortem action items: 1) Portal alias sync (PRTN-4123) 2) Finance onboarding checklist for new entities 3) Marketplace MSA addendum template. I'll start a doc and share.
Rajesh: I'll draft the addendum and share for review. :memo:
